title: Unistationarity of Type II_l and Type V autocatalytic cores with nonnegative degradation
summary: We prove that reversible Type II_l autocatalytic cores with l at least three and Type V cores admit at most one positive stationary state when every degradation rate is nonnegative. The Type II result assumes source-minimality, while the Type V statement uses its literal normal form. Strictly positive reaction rate constants are retained throughout. A reduction to the fork skeleton, source-exhaustion identities and diagonal current criteria control both positive-loss and boundary cases, including internal chains.
